title_or_table: American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B20017, Median Earnings in the Past 12 Months by Sex by Work Experience for the Population 16 Years and Over with Earnings
table_id: ACS 2025 1-year, B20017_003 (men, full-time, year-round) and B20017_006 (women, full-time, year-round)
geography: 50 states and DC, with a United States row (code US)
universe_or_base: People 16 and over with earnings who worked full-time, year-round in the past 12 months
unit: median earnings in 2025 dollars a year with 90 percent margins of error; women_pct_of_men is women's median over men's, computed by the studio, and its margin uses the Census Bureau's approximation for a ratio of two estimates
qualification: Survey estimates; the ratio compares the medians of all full-time, year-round workers and does not compare women and men in the same job. For the United States the Census Bureau's own Table S2002 gives 82 percent (margin 0.3); the data API returned no state values from S2002 on November 11, 2026, so state ratios are computed here. A chart ranks or singles out a state only where the gap passes the margin of error (DR-64)

code.description: USPS state code, US for the nation

women_pct_of_men.description: women's median as a percent of men's, computed

women_pct_of_men_moe.description: approximate 90 percent margin of error, computed

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 1-year estimates, Table B20017, median earnings of full-time, year-round workers by sex, 2025, 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Survey estimates; ratios and their margins computed by Oath & Action; each median covers all such workers, whatever their jobs.
